mentions.name: LineLedger
mentions.description: LineLedger is an open source (AGPL) accounting application for small companies, built as a self-hosted alternative to paying for multiple QuickBooks subscriptions.
mentions.problem: The author runs a few small companies in BC and got tired of paying for seven QuickBooks subscriptions.
mentions.source_excerpt: LineLedger - open source (AGPL) accounting. I run a few small companies in BC and got sick of paying for 7 QuickBooks subscriptions, so I built my own.
